assertions.description: WebTransport.prototype exposes getStats() as a function.
getStats() is declared with no arguments (Function.length is 0).
Calling getStats() on a session returns a Promise.
assertions.test: (()=>{if(typeof WebTransport!=='function'||typeof WebTransport.prototype.getStats!=='function')return false;const t=new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never');t.closed.catch(()=>{});const p=t.getStats();if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(()=>{});try{t.close();}catch(e){}return p instanceof Promise;})()

assertions.description: getStats() called on a non-WebTransport object returns a promise rejected with TypeError rather than throwing synchronously (WebIDL promise-returning operation).
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(typeof WebTransport!=='function'||typeof WebTransport.prototype.getStats!=='function')return false;let p;try{p=WebTransport.prototype.getStats.call({});}catch(e){return false;}if(!(p instanceof Promise))return false;try{await p;return false;}catch(e){return e instanceof TypeError;}})()

assertions.description: Once a session has failed to establish, getStats() rejects with an InvalidStateError DOMException.
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(typeof WebTransport!=='function'||typeof WebTransport.prototype.getStats!=='function')return false;const t=new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never');t.closed.catch(()=>{});const to=(p)=>Promise.race([p,new Promise((_,r)=>setTimeout(()=>r(new Error('timeout')),10000))]);try{await to(t.ready);return false;}catch(e){}try{await t.getStats();return false;}catch(e){return e instanceof DOMException&&e.name==='InvalidStateError';}})()

assertions.description: getStats() called while the session is still connecting waits for the state change and, when establishment fails, rejects with InvalidStateError no earlier than ready rejects.
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(typeof WebTransport!=='function'||typeof WebTransport.prototype.getStats!=='function')return false;const t=new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never');t.closed.catch(()=>{});let readyDone=false;t.ready.then(()=>{readyDone=true;},()=>{readyDone=true;});const to=(p)=>Promise.race([p,new Promise((_,r)=>setTimeout(()=>r(new Error('timeout')),10000))]);try{await to(t.getStats());return false;}catch(e){return e instanceof DOMException&&e.name==='InvalidStateError'&&readyDone;}})()

assertions.description: On an established session getStats() resolves a WebTransportConnectionStats dictionary whose required datagrams member is an object and whose estimatedSendRate is a number or null; after close() it still resolves with the most recent stats.
assertions.test: Needs a reachable HTTP/3 WebTransport server (none ships with this showcase, and QUIC to public servers is often blocked). Run the stats-snapshot and lifecycle-edges concept pages against your own echo server; see the feature page's local echo server recipe.
